text:
Assistant B is better because it includes a subject line and uses a more natural, friendly tone suitable for a friend. It also includes a specific offer of support ("I'll be there to support you every step of the way"), which is a much more persuasive argument for an introverted person than Assistant A's generic assurance that they have "nothing to worry about." Assistant B is also more concise, adhering better to the user's request.

[[B]]
